name: Pre-marched Shadow and Ambient Occlusion Baking
definition: A technique to improve visual fidelity and performance by pre-calculating shadow and ambient occlusion data into the volume texture, leveraging the static nature of the cloud volume.
summary: Pre-marched Shadow and Ambient Occlusion Baking pre-calculates lighting into volume textures for static clouds, trading one-time baking costs for fast runtime lookups instead of real-time ray marching.
